title: Fix background music not starting after user interaction

requirements.text: Make background music reliably start after a user gesture across modern browsers (including mobile Safari/Chrome) even when the initial autoplay attempt is blocked, so that tapping/clicking anywhere on the page (including the Yes/No buttons) starts playback when music is enabled.

quotes: No still the music is not playing even after clicking no or tapping on screen elsewhere

acceptanceCriteria: With music enabled, after a fresh page load on a browser that blocks autoplay, the first user gesture (click/tap anywhere on the page, including pressing Yes/No) starts the audio within 1 second.
If playback is blocked initially, the app registers a user-gesture listener (e.g., pointerdown/touchend/keydown) that re-attempts audio.play() and then removes itself once playback succeeds.
Playback continues looping across stage transitions (question -> celebration) without restarting unexpectedly.
If the user toggles music OFF, audio pauses immediately; toggling ON triggers a play attempt and, if blocked, waits for the next user gesture to start.

requirements.text: Improve audio load/readiness and error handling so the app can detect and surface when the audio asset cannot be loaded from /assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3 (e.g., missing file, 404, decode error) instead of silently never playing.
acceptanceCriteria: If the audio file fails to load (network error/404/decode), the app sets a distinct error state (not just console noise) and does not keep waiting on canplaythrough indefinitely.
The music control UI communicates a clear English status when audio is unavailable (e.g., "Audio failed to load") and the toggle does not misleadingly imply that music is playing.

Audio readiness does not rely solely on the canplaythrough event; readiness becomes true when the browser indicates playable state (e.g., canplay/loadeddata/readyState) so playback can start on slower networks/devices.

requirements.text: Update the UI to provide an unobtrusive, accessible prompt when music is enabled but blocked by autoplay policy, guiding the user to tap to enable sound and offering a direct control to start playback.

quotes: even after clicking no or tapping on screen elsewhere

acceptanceCriteria: When music is enabled and the app detects it needs a user gesture to start (autoplay blocked), an on-screen prompt appears in English (e.g., "Tap to enable sound") and is keyboard-accessible.
Tapping/clicking the prompt triggers a play attempt; once playback succeeds, the prompt disappears.
The existing header music toggle remains present and accessible (aria-labels remain in English), and the new prompt does not break layout on mobile.

constraints: Do not stream audio from YouTube; keep using a static frontend asset at /assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3.
Do not route audio bytes through the backend; keep this purely frontend/static.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Keep all backend logic unchanged (backend/main.mo remains empty unless strictly necessary).
nonGoals: Adding new songs, playlists, or volume sliders beyond what is required to make current playback reliable.
Adding authentication, user accounts, or any backend persistence for audio playback beyond existing localStorage preference behavior.
Implementing real-time features or third-party audio/CDN integrations.
